newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Kiwi Gold announces 1:1 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Kiwi Gold announces 1:1 rights issue.

text.p: Kiwi Gold Ltd said on Friday it intended to make a non renounceable rights issue.

Each shareholder of Kiwi Gold will be entitled to subscribe for one new ordinary share with an issue price of A$0.08 (to be converted into New Zealand dollars on date of issue) for every share held in the company.
The company said it intended that the issue would be partially underwritten to a specified amount.
To the extent that any shortfall is less than the specified amount, the underwriter and its sub underwriters will subscribe for additional shares at A$0.08 per share.
The issue and placement are subject to statutory and shareholder approvals.
Kiwi Gold said money raised from the issue and placement will provide it with the capacity for investment and development within the resource industry.
